# Yushan Ventures

> Technology strategy and scouting, Taiwan supply chain and build, venture and investment advisory, and startup growth.

Public website for Yushan Ventures. Its work covers industrial technology, including compound semiconductors, AI and robotics, optics and sensing. Use the linked pages as the source for services and examples. Historical case studies are not a statement of current availability or an offer from a named client.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://yushanventures.com/): Firm overview, people and contact information.
- [Services](https://yushanventures.com/services.html): Service areas and approach.
- [Case studies](https://yushanventures.com/case-studies.html): Published project examples.
- [Taiwan supply chain](https://yushanventures.com/taiwan-supply-chain.html): Hardware sourcing and build support.
